hero.title: SaaS building blocks for indie devs
hero.subtitle: EzStart ships the plumbing so you can ship the product: auth, payments, analytics and more — production-ready, open-source, ready to drop into your stack.

products.title: Our SaaS lineup
products.subtitle: One monorepo, seven services. Use them standalone or stitched together.

items.name: EZAuth
items.description: Drop-in auth: email/password, OAuth, 2FA, API keys, admin dashboards. Dogfooded across every EzStart app.

items.name: EZPay
items.description: Stripe-powered billing with per-app scoping, HMAC-signed callbacks, donation widgets and federated dashboards.

items.name: EZBill
items.tagline: Invoicing for solo devs and freelancers
items.description: Create clients, send invoices, track payments. Minimal friction, opinionated UX, works out of the box.

items.name: EZStart Hub
items.description: Platform hub: manage every app, user and API key from a single superadmin dashboard.

items.name: GreenPulse
items.description: Turn 45-minute paper forms into 8-15 minute AI-assisted workflows. Multi-modal inputs, multi-tenant by design.

items.name: FengShui
items.description: Generate birth charts and compatibility reports powered by classical BaZi calculus.

items.name: ASC-TCD
items.description: Members, seasons, matches and championship rankings for the ASC-TCD sports club.

founder.title: Built by Franck Dufournet
founder.tagline: Full-stack engineer, CTO-for-hire, turning side projects into SaaS since 2020.
founder.bio: Franck is the one-person engineering team behind EzStart LLC. Ten years of frontend, five in full-stack, three running production MongoDB / Node / React stacks for clients from DeFi to ESG. Obsessed with agnostic packages, clean provider stacks, and shipping boring reliable software.

portfolio.title: Selected client work
portfolio.subtitle: A few highlights from the last three years.

projects.title: Coreum DEX Platform
projects.subtitle: Full-stack DeFi on Cosmos
projects.summary: Led a full SQL-to-Prisma migration (3-4x perf), built SSE real-time infra for 200+ pools, shipped WebSocket chat and PnL analytics. 320 hours across 8 weeks.

projects.title: GreenPulse — AI Form System
projects.subtitle: Intelligent ESG data collection
